# Panes rearranged by dragging (here, the drop a drag ends with): beside
# another pane, the side the pointer is nearest, or onto its middle to
# trade places. Split Best Fit splits along the longer side. Without
# split-autobalance a split halves its pane.
expect-layout:a
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
expect-layout:h50(a,b)
# b (focused) dropped on a's lower half: below it.
drop:1:down
expect-layout:v50(a,b)
# Onto a's middle: they trade places.
drop:1:swap
expect-layout:v50(b,a)
# b is wide now: Best Fit puts the new pane beside it…
action:new_split:auto
wait:0.8
expect-layout:v50(h50(b,c),a)
# …and so is c, a quarter of the window: beside it too…
action:new_split:auto
wait:0.8
expect-layout:v50(h50(b,h50(c,d)),a)
# …but d is tall: below it.
action:new_split:auto
wait:0.8
expect-layout:v50(h50(b,h50(c,v50(d,e))),a)
